contract: Road user a turns to the right from an observed onset: over one continuous stretch in which it moves and its heading turns to the right, its heading changes to the right by at least the turn angle, the heading change below which turning counts as no change of course. Measured as drv.motion.turning_right (with the yaw tolerance and the speed tolerance) holding at every observation since the observation at which it last became true, and the heading change since that observation (integrated from kin.yaw_rate, degrees, left positive, with the step bound, the largest interval between consecutive observations integrated across) at or below the negative of the turn angle. The act's observed beginning is the observation at which drv.motion.turning_right last became true. The act is recognized at the observation at which the heading change since that beginning first reaches the negative of the turn angle: at the beginning itself where the heading change there, which is zero, already reaches it, and otherwise at the first later observation of the same stretch at which it does. The concept holds at the recognition observation only. Conduct before the observed beginning is no part of the act, a heading change accumulated over an earlier stretch included, and where that beginning is not observed (the stretch began before the recording, or an unknown turning state could hide its start) whether the act occurred is unknown. A stretch that ends before its heading change reaches the negative of the turn angle is no turn; a road user that follows a bend of the way through that angle turns in this sense. Not a stand-in for the turn indicator or a declared intention to turn, nor for a lane change, whose heading change stays short of the turn angle.

params.name: turn_angle
params.meaning: the heading change below which turning counts as no change of course

params.name: yaw_tolerance
params.meaning: the yaw rate magnitude below which a change of heading counts as none

params.name: speed_tolerance
params.meaning: the speed at or below which the road user counts as at rest

params.name: step
params.meaning: the step bound of the heading integration, the largest interval between consecutive observations integrated across

act.onset: The act's observed beginning is the observation at which drv.motion.turning_right last became true.
act.recognition: The act is recognized at the observation at which the heading change since that beginning first reaches the negative of the turn angle: at the beginning itself where the heading change there, which is zero, already reaches it, and otherwise at the first later observation of the same stretch at which it does.
act.extent: The concept holds at the recognition observation only.
act.history: Conduct before the observed beginning is no part of the act, a heading change accumulated over an earlier stretch included, and where that beginning is not observed (the stretch began before the recording, or an unknown turning state could hide its start) whether the act occurred is unknown.

elements.span: drv.motion.turning_right (with the yaw tolerance and the speed tolerance) holding at every observation since the observation at which it last became true
elements.justification: drv.motion.turning_right is 'Road user a is turning to the right at an observation: it moves and its heading turns to the right'; its last rise is the act's onset, and its holding at every observation since is the one continuous stretch.

elements.span: the heading change since that observation (integrated from kin.yaw_rate, degrees, left positive, with the step bound, the largest interval between consecutive observations integrated across)
elements.justification: kin.yaw_rate is the 'rate of change of heading, positive when the heading turns to the left', integrated from the onset, where it is zero, so a right turn is a negative change; kin.time is the 'instant of observation of a scene', whose consecutive intervals the integration spans and the step bound limits. 'Not a stand-in for: road curvature' agrees with the contract's bend clause.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: a, moving, yaws right briefly and straightens, then starts yawing right again at a junction and keeps yawing until its heading has turned a quarter turn to the right from that second onset; the concept holds where the change since the second onset first reaches the negative of the turn angle, not where the first and second stretches together would.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: a drifts right for a lane change; its yaw stops long before the heading change reaches the turn angle.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: a turns at a junction, but the source supplies no yaw rate.

differs_from.why: the opposite hand: a rightward stretch (drv.motion.turning_right) and a heading change at or below the negative of the turn angle
